rows.label: Pass defense
rows.tip: Rated on every play: EPA allowed per dropback, this season so far (counts 36% now) blended with last season. Higher = softer; rank 1 = toughest of 32. In 2023–25 ESPN’s projection for WRs moved 1.6% per sd of softer pass defense (range +0.3% to +2.9%), so a bigger role has more to move: +0.2 pts per sd on his 11.9 (range 0.0 to +0.3). After ESPN’s number the same rating explained −0.2 pts per sd (range −0.5 to +0.2) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.

rows.label: Role
rows.tip: From the Roles screen. Usage trends describe what changed; in backtests they added almost nothing once ESPN’s number and the consensus rankings were known.

bottom.headline: Go with ESPN’s 11.9. The matchup is already in it.
lines: NYJ’s pass defense is soft (27th of 32, 1 = toughest). About +0.2 of his 11.9 is that matchup, and a normal week misses by ±7.8.
Once ESPN’s number was counted, the rating still explained −0.2 pts per sd in 2023–25 (range −0.5 to +0.2): nothing to add or subtract.
Not in the number: injury news, teammates who are out, weather. Check those before kickoff.
